name: EPIC 212092964
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 7.0 solar radii and 0.93 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,018 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.93 solar masses and 7.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,654 K at its surface.
